reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with a report for my batch is more than most TikTok supplements give me. $24.99 for the first box is an easy impulse buy, and the empty-box refund makes it low risk.
objection: It is still two capsules every day, and I do not know if I will stick with it. I also have no idea if my magnesium is actually low, so I might be paying for something I do not need.
would_change_my_mind: If it were one capsule instead of two, or if the price at checkout were closer to $35 or more with no launch discount.
